source_scope: all procurement notices accessible through the currently available official read API; rejected or inaccessible ranges and resources are recorded as gaps and excluded from the accessible universe

history.coverage_start_basis: conservative operational start over two years before the official PNCP launch in August 2021; all 2020 windows including the incompletely probed 2020-12-31 are inside the mission; pre-2019 backdated records remain a documented residual risk, not a claim of absolute earliest date
history.fixed_end_filter_semantics_basis: empirical union of adjacent daily publication and global-update windows in modality 1 on 2026-10-13/14, including page replay; applies to accessible API operations and requires reconciliation during collection
history.window_limit_basis: both publication and global-update accepted 2025-01-01 through 2025-12-31 (365 days) with HTTP 200; publication rejected 1900-01-01 through 2020-12-31 with HTTP 422 stating period exceeds 365 days; annual pages require mutable-pagination reconciliation
history.coverage_definition: all records returned by the accessible official API over audited date and modality partitions; inaccessible resources or rejected ranges are classified as gaps, while timeouts and throttling remain pending until retried or explicitly exhausted
history.modality_catalog_basis: GET /v1/modalidades returned currently exposed codes 1-19; statusAtivo=false returned an empty list on 2026-10-29; removed codes cannot be queried from the observed catalogue and are outside the accessible universe unless later discovered
history.inactive_modality_probe: 2026-10-29: GET statusAtivo=false returned HTTP 200 with empty array; removed historical codes remain unverified
history.date_filter_sample: 2026-10-29: modality 1 daily/combined publication and global-update windows for 2026-10-13 and 2026-10-14 had equal identity unions; empirical boundary behavior only, timezone and full historical semantics unverified

official_limits.source_of_known_fields: live consultation OpenAPI retrieved 2026-10-28; 365-day cap observed in live HTTP 422 on 2026-10-29, with both listing routes accepting a 365-day 2025 window
official_limits.current_terms_and_numeric_quota_status: numeric quota and terms not identified in retrieved OpenAPI; source policy review pending

mission_budget.attempts_consumed_authoritative_source: control.source_missions and control.source_budgets in the isolated C2 target; policy file is not a live counter
mission_budget.effective_limits_basis: Locally authorized finite test: at least 1000 ms between reservations, one in-flight request, adaptive backoff on HTTP 429 or malformed HTML/JSON HTTP 200; no official PNCP numeric quota asserted
mission_budget.future_budget_status: 2026-11-04 finite 24-hour restart after Docker/runtime interruption; cumulative mission cap 100000 already includes 2113 consumed attempts, source cap 100099 includes 99 earlier nonmission attempts; 90000 per Sao Paulo day; 100 interrupted-window attempts remain consumed
mission_budget.source_scope: all PNCP missions sharing the same effective credential or IP restriction

sizing.formula: sum(ceil(records_per_partition / approved_page_size)) + enrichment + reconciliation + retry_margin; minimum duration = attempts * effective minimum interval
